players.bio: Aaron Anthony Connolly (born 28 January 2000) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for EFL League One club Leyton Orient and the Republic of Ireland national team.

Alexander George Henry Gilbert is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. Gilbert is a graduate of the West Bromwich Albion Academy and began his professional career with Brentford in 2020. After failing to break into the first team, he transferred to Middlesbrough in 2023.
Alfie Gilchrist (born 28 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Leyton Orient, on loan from EFL Championship club West Bromwich Albion.

Armando Dobra (born 14 April 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. Born in England, he represents Albania's youth teams internationally. Ipswich Town Dobra joined the Ipswich Town academy in 2017, progressing through the youth system at Portman Road.

Charlie Wellens (born 5 December 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. Club career Manchester United and Oldham loan Wellens signed his first professional contract with Manchester United in May 2020.

Dane Pharrell Scarlett (born 24 March 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. Scarlett has represented England up to under-21 level and was a member of the 2022 UEFA European Under-19 Championship-winning squad.

Demetri Kareem Mitchell (born 11 January 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back or as a winger for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. Mitchell started his youth career with Fletcher Moss Rangers; the same academy where teammates Cameron Borthwick-Jackson and Marcus Rashford also started their careers.

Dylan James Christopher Levitt (born 17 November 2000) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Hibernian and the Wales national team. Levitt is a graduate of the Manchester United youth system. He made his senior debut for the club in a UEFA Europa League match in November 2019.

Finley John Stevens (born 10 April 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Leyton Orient and the Wales national team. Stevens is a graduate of the Arsenal Academy and began his senior career in non-League football with Worthing. He is a current Wales U21 international.

Idris El Mizouni (born 26 September 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. Born in France, he has played for the Tunisia national team.
Isaac Hayden has officially signed for League One club Leyton Orient. Born in England, he plays for the Jamaica national team.

James William Morris is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for League One club Leyton Orient. Club career Morris signed his first professional contract with Southampton in August 2020, having been with his boyhood club since joining at Under-10's. On 4 June 2021, Southampton announced their retained list which confirmed Morris had been released.

Jaze Kevin Kabia is an Irish professional football player who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. He started his career with Cobh Ramblers, before moving to Shelbourne, Livingston, Falkirk, Greenock Morton, Queen of the South, Cork City, Clyde and Truro City.
Joseph Olugbenga Olowu (born 27 November 1999) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Leyton Orient.

Lemar Gordon is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a winger for League One club Leyton Orient F.C.. Primarily operating on the left wing, he can also play across the midfield and on the right flank.
Nathan Joseph Baxter (born 8 November 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Leyton Orient.

Adetokunbo Adewale Ayomide Oyekunle (born 9 January 2007), known as Nicholas Oyenkunle, is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Leyton Orient, on loan from EFL Championship club Southampton.

Noah Phillips (born 7 December 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One side Leyton Orient. Career Phillips began his career in the academy at Leyton Orient. In September 2021, Phillips experienced his first taste of first team football, making three appearances out on loan at Hornchurch.

Oliver Lukas Dozae Nnonyelu Dovin (born 11 July 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Leyton Orient on loan from Premier League club Coventry City. Born in England, he plays for the Sweden national team.
Oliver John O'Neill (born 8 January 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Leyton Orient and the Republic of Ireland U21 team.

Paul Gallagher (born 8 September 1984) is a Scottish former professional footballer who played as a midfielder. He is currently a first team coach at League One club Leyton Orient. Born in Glasgow, he played in the Premier League for Blackburn Rovers, and the Football League for Stoke City (two spells), Preston North End (four spells), Plymouth Argyle, Leicester City and Sheffield United.

Phillip Chinedu (born 5 October 2006) is a 20-year-old professional footballer who plays as a defender for Leyton Orient F.C. in the English Football League (EFL) League One. He is primarily a centre-back but can also operate as a left-back.
Rarmani River Miguel Joseph Edmonds-Green (born 14 January 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Leyton Orient.

Richard Paul Wellens (born 26 March 1980) is an English professional football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is the manager of EFL League Two club Salford City. Wellens began his career at Manchester United before signing for Blackpool in 2000, where he went on to win promotion from League Two via the playoffs in 2001.

Sean James Kweku Clare (born 18 September 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender or midfielder for Leyton Orient. He has previously played for Sheffield Wednesday and had loan spells at Bury, Accrington Stanley and Gillingham. After leaving the Nike Academy, Clare signed a contract with Sheffield Wednesday until 2017.

Somto Boniface (Somtochukwu Alan Udochukwu Boniface) is a 20-year-old professional English footballer who plays as a left-back. He currently plays for Leyton Orient, where he is spending the 2026–27 season on loan from Premier League side Ipswich Town.

Theodore Valentine Archibald (born 5 March 1998) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a right winger. He is a product of the Celtic academy and has been capped by Scotland at youth level.

Tony Gary Springett is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. Born in England, he has represented the Republic of Ireland internationally at youth level. Springett joined Norwich City at the age of 12. On 8 May 2022, Springett made his debut for Norwich, coming on as a half-time substitute in a 4–0 Premier League loss against West Ham United.

William Samuel Forrester is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Leyton Orient. He made his professional debut at Stoke City in May 2021, and spent time on loan at Mansfield Town, before signing with Port Vale in July 2022.
Yusuf Akhamrich is an professional footballer who plays as a right winger or right midfielder for EFL League One club Leyton Orient, on loan from Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur.
